title: User Management

toolbar.searchDescription: Filters the currently loaded user list by displayName or email. Applied client-side against the current page of results. Does not trigger a new API call on each keystroke.

primaryAction.label: Invite User
primaryAction.description: Opens the Invite User modal to send a new user invitation and assign an initial planner-service role. Not available to planner-admin.

filters.label: Role
filters.name: role
filters.description: Filter users by assigned planner-service role

columns.description: User display name from Keycloak JWT claims
User email address. Protected A field — visible in full to tenant-admin; masked (***@domain.ca) to planner-admin.
columns.securityNote: FAC-S5-025: email is Protected A. Use MaskedField component for planner-admin view. Full email rendered to tenant-admin only. Annotate component with // ASVS:V-8.3.1 // CAS:RULE-017

columns.description: Current planner-service role assignment: planner-user or planner-admin

rowActions.label: Edit Role
rowActions.description: Inline role selector to change user planner-service role between planner-user and planner-admin. On selection change triggers updateUser PATCH with new role value. Server generates audit event per BR-008 and SN-012.
rowActions.auditNote: TC-082: Role change generates immutable audit event server-side via updateUser (BR-008). Client does not need to trigger audit logging.

rowActions.label: Deactivate
rowActions.description: Soft-deactivates the user account within the tenant. Prompts a confirmation dialog before proceeding. Server generates audit event per BR-008.

confirmDialog.title: Deactivate User
confirmDialog.body: Are you sure you want to deactivate this user? They will no longer be able to access the ADSP Project Planner.

inviteModal.title: Invite User
inviteModal.description: Send an invitation to a new user and assign their initial planner-service role within this tenant. Invitation is sent via createUser POST to /api/v1/users.

fields.label: Email Address
fields.name: email
fields.validation: Required. Must be a valid email address format.
fields.securityNote: FAC-S5-026: Email entered in modal is held as component state only. Not written to localStorage or sessionStorage. Cleared on modal close or success.

fields.label: Role
fields.name: role
fields.description: Initial role assignment for the invited user within this tenant

fields.label: Display Name
fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Optional display name. If omitted, identity will be resolved from Keycloak on the user's first login.

inviteModal.successMessage: Invitation sent. The user will receive an email with instructions to access the ADSP Project Planner.

errorStates.message: A user with this email address already exists in your tenant.
You do not have permission to invite users.

pagination.description: Server-side pagination via page and pageSize params on GET /api/v1/users

emptyState.message: No users have been added to this tenant yet.

onLoad.description: Fetches paginated list of users in the current tenant with their assigned roles, status, and last activity. Requires planner-admin or tenant-admin role.
onLoad.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: No Protected A fields (email, displayName) are passed as URL query params. Only standard pagination params used.

onSubmit.description: Creates (invites) a new user with initial role. Triggered by Invite User modal submit action.
onSubmit.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: Email and role are submitted in POST request body, never in URL query string. FAC-S5-026: Modal form state cleared after submit.

onSubmit.description: Updates user role assignment. Triggered by Edit Role inline dropdown selection change. Generates server-side audit event per BR-008 (TC-082).
onSubmit.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: userId is a route parameter only (/users/{userId}). Role value is submitted in PATCH request body.

onSubmit.description: Soft-deactivates user account within tenant after confirmation dialog. Generates server-side audit event per BR-008.
onSubmit.securityNote: FAC-S5-024: userId is a route parameter only. No body params. Deactivation is a soft delete (status=inactive).

validationErrors.message: Please enter a valid email address.
Please select a role for this user.

dataBindings.emptyState: No users have been added to this tenant yet.

accessControl.restrictedNote: planner-admin can read the user list (listUsers) but all write row actions (Edit Role, Deactivate) and the Invite User button are hidden. Email column is masked to ***@domain for planner-admin.
accessControl.deniedMessage: You do not have permission to access User Management. This area is restricted to tenant administrators.

errorStates.condition: 403 — planner-user attempts to access User Management
errorStates.message: You do not have permission to access User Management.
No users have been added to this tenant yet.
User list is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few moments.
A user with this email address already exists in your tenant.
User not found. The user list will refresh.

protectedFields.maskingRule: FAC-S5-025: email rendered full to tenant-admin; masked (***@domain) to planner-admin using MaskedField component
protectedFields.storageNote: FAC-S5-026: Email collected in invite modal as form state only. Cleared on modal close or success. Never written to localStorage or sessionStorage.

protectedFields.maskingRule: No masking required for displayName — non-sensitive display data rendered as-is.

securityContext.urlLeakageNote: FAC-S5-024: Email and role values are submitted in POST/PATCH request bodies (inviteModal via createUser, role edit via updateUser). userId appears as route parameter only (/users/{userId}). No Protected A fields placed in URL query strings.
securityContext.storageNote: FAC-S5-026: No user PII (email, displayName) written to localStorage or sessionStorage. User list data held in component state. Invite form fields are component state; cleared on modal close or successful submission.

auditTrail.description: All role changes (updateUser PATCH) and account deactivations (deactivateUser DELETE) generate immutable audit events server-side per BR-008. Client spec does not trigger audit logging directly — it is server-side behaviour transparent to the UI.

scopeNote: tenant-admin role itself is managed via Keycloak directly and is outside scope for this page. This page manages planner-service roles only: planner-user and planner-admin assignments within the tenant.

tcCoverage.description: TC-036: planner-user denied admin access (403 error state). TC-039: no-role user denied (403 error state). TC-055: keyboard navigation for toolbar search, filter drawer, table rows, row action dropdowns, and invite modal form fields. TC-057: colour contrast for status badges, error states, and destructive action buttons. TC-082: audit event generated on role change via updateUser — verified by checking audit log after role edit.

policyNotices.description: All user role assignments and deactivations are recorded in the immutable audit log per SN-012.
Role assignment is governed by BR-016. tenant-admin role itself is managed via Keycloak directly and is out of scope for this page.
Write operations (createUser, updateUser, deactivateUser) generate audit events server-side per BR-008.

metadata.note: No dedicated UC in use_cases.json for user-management. Governed by BR-016 (role assignment) and SN-012 (audit trail on role change). Full Keycloak tenant-admin role management is delegated to ADSP Access Service and is out of scope. This page manages planner-service roles only. createUser (POST /api/v1/users) used for invite flow — verified in openapi.yaml at line 1077.
